test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average age of 40 students in a class is 12 years. The average age of the students increased by 4 months due to 20 new admissions in the class. The average age of the newly admitted students is:
solution:
**Given:**

n₁ = 40, avg₁ = 12 years

n₂ = 20, increase in avg = 4/12 years

avgₙₑw = 12 + 1/3 = 37/3 years

**Calculation:**

Initial total age = 40 × 12 = 480 years

New total age = (40 + 20) × 37/3 = 60 × 37/3 = 740 years

Age of new students = 740 - 480 = 260 years

Average age of new students = 260 / 20 = 13 years

**∴ Average age of new students = 13 years.**
